decisions.reason: As a low-risk extension close to the existing catalog in a growing market, the schlager compilation gives no clear sign of falling below aspiration, so a mature specialist retailer-label would likely keep it while monitoring fit and sales.

The illustrated music release series builds directly on the firm's curatorial strengths and product-development experience, and without evidence of underperformance the firm is likely to retain this broader line under satisfactory-performance logic.
